about: Patrol 'caret' of a character walking a spline (patrolling guards, wandering NPCs): which spline, the current control point, positions and state. Run by esv::patrol::CaretSystem (Toolkit names: Activate, Enable, Disable, TryPlace, UpdateInactive, ProcessClearRequests, ClearBSPatrolState) and read by esv::ActivationManager. macOS has a method on the component itself, esv::patrol::CaretComponent::GotoNextSplinePoint(ls::SplineTemplate const&). The struct is 4-byte aligned (size 0x54), so it holds no pointers. Seen.py context: helm/idle levels and many dialogues (CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration, DEN refugees) - NPCs with patrol splines.

evidence.says: Registration bg3.exe+0x26FF170 sets destructor bg3.exe+0x698FE0 = FixedString release at +0; macOS default ctor writes -1 (null) in the low dword of +0. Live: 46 distinct FixedString indices. Probably the spline (template) id; the name is a guess. Converter bg3.exe+0x277FF60 (model ls::model::game::patrol::v1::CaretComponent, 72 bytes -> runtime 0x54) fills it with a FixedString created from the model's leading Guid (formatted %08x-%04hx-...): the spline's id. The save loader bg3.exe+0x2591640 copies the runtime struct into the 0x54-byte component member by member with this width.

Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xA49380 esv::patrol::CaretSystem::Setup(..., esv::patrol::InitData const&, bool) writes caret +4 = InitData +4 and passes it as the direction bool of ls::SplineTemplate::GetClosestLocationInDirection. InitData +4 is the 'reversed' argument of the Anubis function StartCaretPatrol: macOS bg3_macos_x64+0x30F6900 reads the bool argument named 'reversed' and hands it to ls::anubis::game::DoPatrolImpl (bg3_macos_x64+0x3337CD0), which stores it at InitData +4. GotoNextSplinePoint reads +4 to choose the direction of travel.

Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xA49380 esv::patrol::CaretSystem::Setup writes caret +5 = InitData +5 (and only updates +5 when the rest of the setup is unchanged). InitData +5 is the eoc::EPathMovementSpeed argument named 'pathMovementSpeed' of the Anubis function StartCaretPatrol (bg3_macos_x64+0x30F6900 -> DoPatrolImpl bg3_macos_x64+0x3337CD0, stored at InitData +5). Live 1..3, macOS default 2.

Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xA49380 esv::patrol::CaretSystem::Setup writes caret +6 = InitData +6. InitData +6 is the bool argument named 'reverseIfBlocked' of the Anubis function StartCaretPatrol (bg3_macos_x64+0x30F6900; default 1 when the argument is left out), ANDed by DoPatrolImpl (bg3_macos_x64+0x3337CD0) with a flag of the spline. macOS default 1.

survey.names_pass_2: No game names found: the savegame model ls::model::game::patrol::v1::CaretComponent has no named visitor in the macOS symbols (savefields.py), the component is not replicated and no Osiris parameter maps to it.
open_questions: Member names: the savegame model has no named visitor, so only SplineId, SplinePointIndex and State carry inferred names; meanings of the flags, the -1337 block and the trailing dwords.
Reading the Toolkit esv::patrol::CaretSystem methods (CreatePath, SetBSPatrolState, RotateToFaceTarget, LegacyRequestClearPatrol) against the converter offsets would name the flags.

survey.second_pass: The Windows save loader bg3.exe+0x2591640 and the model converter bg3.exe+0x277FF60 give every member's offset, width and default (and show +0xA, +0x2E and +0x4D are padding, +0x28 two bytes, not an int16); the two vec3 go through the game's position conversion.
